text:
Sara (Support): Heads-up: Northgate reported a 3x p99 spike and ~40% throughput drop after the 02:10 UTC deploy. Ticket ND-1234 with traces: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/ND-1234 :exclamation:
Omar (Runtime): on it. any sample request_ids or trace ids from the ticket? helps narrow to model/route.
Sara (Support): added two example req_ids in the ticket: rq_0a1b2c and rq_9z8y7x. customer says it started ~02:12 UTC.
Kenji (Infra): Deploy shows kernel-selector flip on the pool that serves northgate at 02:08 UTC (deploy-bot log below)
InfraBot: deploy northgate-runtime pool v3.14 -> v3.15 at 2026-02-04T02:08:07Z (canary 10%)
Lia (SRE): can we confirm if canary was promoted to 100%? I see a gradual rollout, looks like promotion completed at 02:11.
Omar (Runtime): pinging @Kenji — does v3.15 include the new continuous-batching kernel change? that's my top suspect.
Kenji (Infra): yes v3.15 enabled `kbatch_v2` selector by default for gpus with compute>=8. I pushed a revert PR for the selector toggle: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4021
Sara (Support): customer asked for ETA on fix, they are actively throttling traffic to avoid failures.
Omar (Runtime): repro plan: 1) run northgate perf harness w/ seq-dist and p95/p99 load profile 2) profile with perfctl and capture flamegraph 3) run with kernel-selector forced to v3.14
Lia (SRE): commands:
```
./harness/run_load_test --workload northgate --rps 250 --seq-dist heavy
perfctl profile --req-ids rq_0a1b2c --output /tmp/ng-flame.svg
```
Kenji (Infra): I'll force an immediate rollback on the pool and report back (rolling 100% -> v3.14). scheduling now.
InfraBot: rollback northgate-runtime pool to v3.14 started at 2026-02-04T02:34:50Z
Omar (Runtime): added a quick profiling patch to branch `regress/northgate-batch` (small change). can someone run the harness with that build? @Kenji if rollback doesn't normalize throughput, try that build.
Lia (SRE): also check KV-cache hit rates and prefix cache eviction around the time window. those can cause p99 spikes when eviction thrashes.
Sara (Support): I've updated ND-1234 with the rollback steps and customer message. they're on standby for a coordinated test.
Omar (Runtime): thx. @Kenji can you also capture host-level metrics (nvlink/mem/bandwidth) and gc pauses on the same timeframe? put links here.
Kenji (Infra): uploading graphs to ticket now. nvlink saturations spikes at 02:10, mem copies higher than baseline.
Lia (SRE): assigning follow-ups: Omar -> runtime bisect + flamegraphs, Kenji -> infra rollback + metrics, Sara -> customer comms. I'll own the postmortem doc skeleton.
Omar (Runtime): quick ask — if someone can approve PR #4021 revert (CI passed), I can promote the revert and cut a hotfix build.
Kenji (Infra): approving now. merging and kicking hotfix image build.
InfraBot: hotfix image build started (image: northgate/runtime:hotfix-188123). ETA ~15m.
Sara (Support): customer replied: appreciate the quick response, will keep traffic low until you confirm.
Lia (SRE): good. keep this thread for async updates, we'll escalate to an incident if rollback/hotfix doesn't restore baseline in 20m. :thumbsup:
